item.title: Synectics profit falls on tough comparator and energy delays but margins rise
item.summary: Synectics reported a drop in first-half revenue and profit, though the decline was largely expected and masked improving margins and progress on a wider strategic overhaul. Revenue at the security and surveillance group dropped 37% to £22.2m in the six months to 31 May, with adjusted EBITDA down to £1.0m from £4.2m, tipping it to […] The post Synectics profit falls on tough comparator and energy delays but margins rise appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
